recentItems.title: ZELENSKYY DEMANDS THE KREMLIN BE BROKEN! THE AGGRESSOR’S OIL GIANTS LIE IN RUINS!
recentItems.description:
Ukrainian long-range drones struck major oil depots and terminals in southern Russia, paralysing the enemy’s fuel logistics.

In response, the occupying forces launched ballistic missiles at Kyiv. Residential buildings were damaged, two people were killed, and at least eight others were injured.

Meanwhile, the Crimea Platform Summit took place in New York, where Volodymyr Zelenskyy called on world leaders to increase pressure on Moscow to restore the authority of international law and achieve the complete de-occupation of Ukraine.

recentItems.title: AMERICAN POWER + UKRAINIAN EXPERIENCE: Abrams tank fitted with an anti-drone armour frame!
recentItems.description:
Ukrainian troops have adapted an M1 Abrams tank to the realities of warfare against FPV drones by welding a sturdy “hedgehog” frame made of metal rods around it to protect the turret and optics.

In an exclusive Army Media report prepared for Major Andrii Makarenko, the crew showed the armoured ammunition compartment with blowout panels designed to save lives even if the shells detonate.

The tank crew also demonstrated for the first time a secret control pedal, known at the front as the “last resort,” and explained why this mechanism can become the vehicle’s final chance in a critical battle.

recentItems.title: ZELENSKYY SECURES A LICENSE TO PRODUCE PATRIOT MISSILES FOR UKRAINE!
recentItems.description:
Ukraine found itself at the centre of attention at the UN General Assembly. The leaders of Latvia and Türkiye spoke in support of the inviolability of Ukraine’s borders, while Volodymyr Zelenskyy held a series of key talks with Western partners. Kyiv proposed an initiative for a mutual halt to strikes on energy infrastructure, and Donald Trump expressed his willingness to support granting Ukraine a licence to produce Patriot systems domestically — production that could be launched within 12–18 months.

Meanwhile, the United Kingdom established a National Information Protection Centre after uncovering a Russian network that cloned the websites of the BBC and 27 other organisations in an attempt to disrupt elections. Similar acts of sabotage have been recorded across Europe, where Ukrainian expertise in countering the Kremlin’s hybrid threats is now being adopted.

recentItems.title: BALLISTIC TERROR IN KYIV WITH CASUALTIES! 277 battles on the front and 1.5 million Russian losses!
recentItems.description:
Ukraine is suffering from relentless aerial terror, including exhausting eight-hour air-raid alerts. Last night, the enemy struck Kyiv with ballistic missiles, killing two people and injuring at least eight others. Volodymyr Zelenskyy urgently discussed strengthening air defence with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte.

In response, Ukraine’s Defence Forces destroyed two Russian radar stations and a launch site for attack drones.

A record 277 battles took place along the front line over the past 24 hours, while the total losses of the Russian army exceeded 1.523 million personnel. Meanwhile, Ukraine and Finland officially formalized cooperation on the joint production of drones.
